summary: Patch correctly saves and restores the handler level, fixing the caplog level leak between tests. Minimal, targeted, matches the existing restore pattern for logger levels.

issues.description: set_level saves handler level with plain assignment (not setdefault like logger levels), so repeated set_level calls overwrite _initial_handler_level with an already-modified level. But since handler.level starts at 0 and both saves capture pre-mutation state correctly on first call, and subsequent calls capture the prior set level — restoration to true original only guaranteed on first call. Edge case, unlikely to matter in practice; logger levels use setdefault for exactly this reason.
